title: Dow Movers: GE, XOM
text:
Dow Movers: GE, XOM
In early trading on Wednesday, shares of Exxon Mobil (XOM) topped the list of the day's best performing Dow Jones Industrial Average components, trading up 1.9%.
Year to date, Exxon Mobil has lost about 4.5% of its value.
And the worst performing Dow component thus far on the day is General Electric (GE), trading down 0.5%.
General Electric is lower by about 19.2% looking at the year to date performance.
Two other components making moves today are Apple (AAPL), trading down 0.3%, and Chevron (CVX), trading up 1.2% on the day.
